class.name: CgamePhysicsRollback
class.brief_description: Connects a [CgameDeterministicPhysics] world to a [CgameRollbackNetcode] and provides lag-compensated ray casts.
class.description: [CgamePhysicsRollback] owns a [CgameDeterministicPhysics] world ([member world]) and acts as the native step provider of a [CgameRollbackNetcode], so rollback and resimulation of physics run without any script call. The state handed to the netcode is [code]{"phys": PackedByteArray, "tick": int}[/code]. Player inputs are dictionaries [code]{"force": Vector3}[/code]; each player owns one body (see [method bind_player]) and the input is applied as a force clamped to [member max_force] for that step. Lag compensation: every simulated state is also kept in a bounded ring (tick to snapshot) so that [method rewind_query] can pose all bodies as they were at a past time, interpolating between the two bracketing snapshots (lerp for positions, slerp for rotations), and cast a ray against that past world. The ring is keyed by tick, so resimulation after a rollback overwrites mispredicted entries with corrected ones. [codeblock] var physics := CgamePhysicsRollback.new() physics.world.add_body(1, CgameDeterministicPhysics.SHAPE_SPHERE, 1.0, Vector3(0, 1, 0), Vector3(0.5, 0, 0)) physics.bind_player(10, 1) var net := CgameRollbackNetcode.new() physics.setup_net(net, [10, 20], [10], 1.0 / 60.0, 2, 8) # Server side lag compensation: var hit := physics.rewind_query(shot_time, muzzle, direction) [/codeblock]

method.name: bind_player
method.description: Assigns the body that is controlled by [param player_id].

method.name: get_dt
method.description: Returns the time step passed to [method setup_net].

method.name: get_player_bodies
method.description: Returns the mapping from player id to body id.

method.name: history_size
method.description: Returns the number of ticks held in the lag-compensation ring.

method.name: initial_state
method.description: Returns the initial netcode state built from the current world and seeds the lag-compensation ring.

method.name: newest_time
method.description: Returns the simulation time of the newest stored tick, in seconds.

method.name: oldest_time
method.description: Returns the simulation time of the oldest stored tick, in seconds.

method.name: rewind_query
method.description: Casts a ray against the world as it was at [param time] (seconds of simulation time, clamped to the stored history). Returns [code]{"hit": bool, "id": int, "t": float, "point": Vector3, "alpha": float, "tick": int}[/code], where [code]tick[/code] is the earlier of the two snapshots that were blended and [code]alpha[/code] the blend factor.

method.name: setup_net
method.description: Configures [param net] to simulate this physics world, using the native step. The netcode keeps a reference to this object.

method.name: state_checksum
method.description: Returns a checksum of the physics snapshot inside [param state].

method.name: step_state
method.description: The pure, deterministic step the netcode uses: restores the snapshot in [param state], applies the player forces in sorted player order, steps the world and returns the new state. It can also be passed as a [Callable] to [method CgameRollbackNetcode.setup].

members.member: The number of ticks kept for lag compensation.
Player input forces are clamped to this length.
The physics world simulated by this adapter.
